name: Apprentice Core Class
description: The main Apprentice class — the composition root and sole public API surface. Constructor takes a config file path (or ApprenticeConfig object) plus optional component overrides for dependency injection. On init: loads config, constructs all internal components (Config Loader → Task Registry → Remote Client → Local Client → Confidence Engine → Sampling Scheduler → Budget Manager → Training Data Store → Router → Audit Log). Exposes three public methods: async run(), async status(), and sync report(). All internal components are stored as single-underscore attributes, accessible for testing but not part of the public API. Implements async context manager protocol for resource lifecycle management. Handles graceful error propagation with exactly three public exception types. Every run() call is audit-wrapped via a RunContext that accumulates routing decisions and flushes to the audit log on completion.

functions.name: run
functions.description: Primary public method. Executes a task: looks up the task in the registry, creates a RunContext, queries confidence and budget state, routes to appropriate model backend (local or remote), handles fallbacks, records spend, stores training data, flushes the audit log entry, and returns a frozen TaskResponse. The caller has zero visibility into routing logic — they get a typed response with source transparency. Error decision matrix: (1) local_available=T, budget_available=T → route normally; (2) local_available=T, budget_available=F → local-only, log warning, status=degraded; (3) local_available=F, budget_available=T → remote-only with fallback cost; (4) local_available=F, budget_available=F → raise BudgetExhaustedError or LocalModelUnavailableError.

invariants: self._config is always a fully validated, frozen ApprenticeConfig instance after __init__ completes
self._running is True if and only if the async context has been entered and not yet exited
run() and status() always raise RuntimeError if self._running is False

All 10 internal components are non-None after __init__ completes: _config_loader, _task_registry, _remote_client, _local_client, _confidence_engine, _sampling_scheduler, _budget_manager, _training_data_store, _router, _audit_log
Budget enforcement is hard: if budget_manager.can_spend() returns False for a task, no remote API call is made for that task
Every run() invocation creates exactly one RunContext, which is flushed to the audit log on completion regardless of success or failure
TaskResponse.source accurately reflects which model backend produced the output — never misattributed
Phase labels are always derived from confidence scores and thresholds — never manually assigned or overridden
Sampling rate is continuous (float in [0.0, 1.0]), never discrete tiers
All return types (TaskResponse, ConfidenceSnapshot, SystemReport) are frozen Pydantic v2 models — immutable after construction
No global state: all state flows through explicit parameters, injected dependencies, or instance attributes
Local model failure with available budget triggers graceful fallback to remote — never crashes
Budget exhaustion with available local model triggers graceful degradation to local-only — never crashes
Only when BOTH local model is unavailable AND budget is exhausted does the system raise an error
Component overrides provided in __init__ completely replace the default-constructed component — no partial merging
close() is idempotent — safe to call multiple times with no side effects after the first call
